title: Kamishiro Rui — Admiring My Treasures〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? What was that light?
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ah! Rui, where are you going?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not going anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?! S-So you're the Rui we came in here with?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
I'm Wonderlands×Showtime's director, Rui Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That being said, what is this phenomenon?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I initially thought I had just shrunk, but now that other Rui looks like I usually do. Which means it's likely more accurate to say that we switched bodies.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's difficult to say whether this constitutes evidence in favor, but my memories up until now are consistent. I suppose it could be some kind of perceptional manipulation—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hooray! It really is our Rui♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My apologies. This is such a fascinating phenomenon that I got carried away.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's okay! We can definitely tell you're the real Rui.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But why did you turn small?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There are too many unknown factors to hazard a guess right now. I need information before anything else.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First, this place. Do you two know anything about it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes! I think you're right that this place was born from feelings♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! It feels more unstable than a SEKAI born from a fragment of a feeling, though...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If I recall, unlike ordinary SEKAI, SEKAI born from fragments of feelings only allow one to connect with their feelings for a short time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Does that mean that if we wait long enough, we'll be able to return to our own SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sorry, I can't really say. Oh, but!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I do know that the emotions the other Rui was feeling do belong to you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... So this was all born from some feeling within me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose the next step is to determine what feeling that was.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm sure there will be clues somewhere in this SEKAI! Let's go look around!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right.
se_walk_men_002_1
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, look at this! There's a bunch of photos?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
There are lots of little Rui, and lots of bigger Rui too!
Is this one here from a school trip?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
This one looks like a sports festival♪
And this one's from Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (My age, who I'm with, and the locations appear random. The order doesn't suggest a pattern, either.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In that case, the content itself is likely what's important.)

rows.Speaker: Rui?
rows.Line:
Well, don't you look like you're having fun.
Nowadays, at least.

rows.Speaker: Rui?
rows.Line: When you were always all alone, before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (From the way my other self was speaking, I think...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, this one only has Rui in it... Wait, huh?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: These photos all have cracks in them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The “cracked” photos are all from the period between elementary school and junior high.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But the ones from the same period that show Nene, or my family, have no cracks...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's as though it's denying the times in my life when I felt alone...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (No. I have it backwards.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ('He' feels as though I, myself, have rejected the person I used to be.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And that feeling of rage... His true identity must be...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I understand now what feelings gave birth to this place.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This SEKAI was born from my feelings of loneliness and isolation.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ack!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm back...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The air feels less heavy somehow, too.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is it because you understood how the other Rui feels?
I'm glad to see that you understand.
se_walk_men_002_1
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ah! It's the first little Rui we met... And?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You must be me from junior high, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello. Does it make sense to say, nice to meet you?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. What a strange feeling, hearing that from your own self.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Rui
rows.Line: I have no strong attachments to what's happening here, but it's been interesting enough, so I've been watching from the sidelines until now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
That does sound like me.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you not angry anymore?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Rui
rows.Line: ...I thought you'd forgotten.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Rui
rows.Line: You have so many friends now, after all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've never forgotten. Not once.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I could never forget those long and lonely days.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Rui
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Rui
rows.Line: Your heart keeps on filling up with happy memories with your friends and teammates.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Rui
rows.Line: It feels like there isn't any space for us, anymore...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's true that I don't feel nearly as alone as I used to, thanks to Tsukasa and the others.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I've never wanted to forget those days, nor do I think I should.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's true that those days left marks that will never fade...
But it's because of them that I know now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ...Just how much of a miracle Wonderlands×Showtime is.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was because of those lonely, painful days that I was able to take that step forward.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I didn't want to make the choice that would split us apart.
Even if it would put us on the shortest roads to each of our dreams.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It drove me to search furiously for a way for the four of us to carry onward together. To cling to that miracle we had found.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At the very least, I don't believe there's such a thing as a memory one is better off without.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Knowing suffering can make one kinder. Knowing sadness helps you treasure the warmth of a smile.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's exactly the same.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Knowing loneliness has shown me the value of companionship...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And that Wonderlands×Showtime is my most priceless treasure in the world.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Rui
rows.Line: Treasure...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You don't have to go anywhere.
You will always have a place here.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Rui
rows.Line: So... We can stay there?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Rui
rows.Line: Because I found a very special treasure.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We're back in our SEKAI!
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe the fragment of a feeling, the little Rui, is a part of you again now♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui! Miku, and Len!
Where have you been?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You just vanished!
We've been looking everywhere!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heeeey! KAITO, everyone!
We found them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What happened? Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm just fine.
There was no problem at all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Because I have you all.)
